pattern: cursor \+ the event log are the position anchor across sessions.{0,30}`TaskList\(\)` is not

name: wave_task_checklist_rebuilds_on_resume
why: Resume-gap fix: the pre-fix rule ('check TaskList() first; if this sprint's tasks already exist, leave them as-is') never recreated the checklist on a resume in a new session — TaskList() is session-scoped, so it always came back empty for this sprint, and the branch that would have recreated it was never written. Fix: on a resume where TaskList() shows none for this sprint but the cursor names it live past `load`, rebuild the full checklist.

name: wave_task_rebuild_derives_from_record
why: Resume-gap fix: the rebuilt checklist's per-wave state is derived from the event log (wave_check_passed / pipeline_tick_completed stage=wave_<N>_gate) and the cursor's wave_number, never guessed or inferred from conversation memory — 'Reconstruct, do not guess.'

name: wave_task_rebuild_never_becomes_authority

name: verify_record_at_sprint_full_tests

why: A falsely-fresh ledger entry is unsafe (D3); only a genuinely clean, all-tiers-passed run may be recorded — for both the per-tier and aggregate keys.

name: dedup_identical_test_tiers

name: dedup_notes_distinct_run_count
why: The dedup decision must be visible in the tick note, not silently absorbed.

name: scoped_substitution_base_files_placeholders
why: Perf plan P6 (issue 4.1): test_commands.scoped/build_commands.scoped had one reader and no mechanism deriving its argument. {base}/{files} placeholders, substituted from the wave base sha and changed-file list, make the shipped scoped examples actually runnable.

name: scoped_widen_emits_event

name: scoped_widen_never_narrow
why: States the mandatory direction of every widen trigger: uncertainty always resolves to running MORE (the full tier), never less.

why: An ecosystem with no scoped form must never be made worse — the existing .unit/.full fallback is untouched when .scoped is empty.

name: preflight_no_full_status_check_1_7_reproduction

name: preflight_still_checks_sprint_task_refs

It must gate on keys that actually exist.

name: goal_mode_preflight_no_bare_test_commands_full_key
why: Regression guard: the gate must not go back to naming test_commands.full as if it were a real, checkable key.

name: verify_record_per_tier_key_scheme
why: Integration fix: /ship-review's Stage 1a and quality-gate checks look up per-tier keys (test_commands.unit/.integration/.e2e), not the aggregate sprint_full_tests key. Recording only the aggregate left Stage 1a's per-tier check permanently stale, delivering zero speedup.

name: verify_record_per_tier_literal_names
why: Pins the exact tier-name vocabulary the per-tier ledger keys must use — must match what /ship-review's Stage 1a checks against, not a paraphrase.

name: dedup_records_one_entry_per_deduped_tier
why: A deduped group (two tier names mapping to one dispatched command) must still record a ledger entry per tier name — otherwise review re-runs the tier that was deduped away, silently defeating the dedup work.

name: verify_record_aggregate_key_matches_full_suite_key
why: Pins that the aggregate ledger key stays the exact literal the terminal gate (evaluateReviewTerminal) checks for release approval — a future rename here would silently break release-gate reuse.

name: verify_record_demo_probe_key_scheme
